subject: RE: Database Migration — Team Coordination Approved
body:
Hi Diana,

Confirming my approval for the database migration on November 3. I've set up the on-call rota — Arjun Mehta will be primary on-call, Riya Desai as backup.

I've also sent the maintenance notification to all@nexora.com as Raj requested.

Please make sure the migration runbook in docs/database-migration-plan.md is updated with the 72-hour rollback window change Raj specified.

Good luck on Sunday!

Priya
